<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>2026 南義大利自駕之旅 | Sicilia to Napoli</title>
    <meta name="description" content="2026 年南義大利自駕之旅：行程、住宿、交通、票券、景點導覽、影片腳本及旅費狀態。">
    <style>
:root {
  --paper: #fffdf8;
  --paper-light: #ffffff;
  --paper-dark: #f5ece2;
  --ink: #243640;
  --ink-soft: #536770;
  --sage: #287d72;
  --vermilion: #b95039;
  --vermilion-soft: #fbeae4;
  --sand: #bc8330;
  --azure: #176b98;
  --rule: rgba(40, 55, 61, 0.14);
  --shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(45, 42, 37, 0.12);
  --title: "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Heiti TC", sans-serif;
  --body: "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Heiti TC", sans-serif;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 14% 8%, rgba(220, 120, 83, 0.11), transparent 31rem),
    linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0 92%, rgba(42, 127, 115, 0.05) 92% 100%),
    var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

body::before {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  content: "";
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(48, 59, 60, 0.08) 0.65px, transparent 0.65px);
  background-size: 7px 7px;
  opacity: 0.34;
}

body::after {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  content: "";
  background-image:
    url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='190' height='620' viewBox='0 0 190 620' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'%3E%3Cpath d='M8 128c28-23 58-23 88 0s58 23 86 0M8 156c28-23 58-23 88 0s58 23 86 0M8 184c28-23 58-23 88 0s58 23 86 0' stroke='%23176b98' stroke-width='2.4' opacity='.24'/%3E%3Cpath d='M35 247c16-30 42-47 78-53l31 87c-42-1-78-12-109-34Z' fill='%23176b98' fill-opacity='.08' stroke='%23176b98' stroke-width='2' opacity='.55'/%3E%3Cpath d='M95 194v88' stroke='%23243640' stroke-width='1.8' opacity='.22'/%3E%3Cpath d='M95 205c18 14 33 32 45 55-19 2-34-3-45-14' fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='.72' stroke='%23243640' stroke-width='1.7' opacity='.24'/%3E%3Cpath d='M95 209c-19 13-34 30-45 51 19 3 34-2 45-15' fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='.62' stroke='%23243640' stroke-width='1.7' opacity='.22'/%3E%3Cpath d='M17 340c21-18 45-26 72-24 24 2 47 15 70 39M21 376c27-17 53-20 78-10s47 24 68 44' stroke='%23bc8330' stroke-width='2.1' opacity='.2'/%3E%3Cpath d='M45 444c18-12 36-12 54 0s36 12 54 0M38 470c22-14 44-14 66 0s44 14 66 0' stroke='%23176b98' stroke-width='2.2' opacity='.2'/%3E%3Cpath d='M40 72c14-17 31-24 52-22-8 18-24 28-47 30' fill='%23287d72' fill-opacity='.13' stroke='%23287d72' stroke-width='2' opacity='.58'/%3E%3Cellipse cx='111' cy='70' rx='15' ry='21' transform='rotate(-20 111 70)' fill='%23f4c96d' fill-opacity='.2' stroke='%23bc8330' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='142' cy='105' r='4' fill='%23b95039' fill-opacity='.23'/%3E%3Cpath d='M70 545c-12-19-15-39-9-61 18 9 29 24 32 45M104 552c1-24 12-42 33-55 11 21 9 42-7 62' stroke='%23287d72' stroke-width='2.1' opacity='.24'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E"),

    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(23, 107, 152, 0.08), transparent 20%, transparent 80%, rgba(23, 107, 152, 0.1));
  background-position:
    left 8px top 112px,
    right 2px top 116px,
    center;
  background-repeat: repeat-y, repeat-y, no-repeat;
  background-size: clamp(124px, 11.8vw, 190px) auto, clamp(132px, 12.4vw, 206px) auto, 100% 100%;
  opacity: 0.86;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

p, h1, h2, h3, figure {
  margin: 0;
}

.topbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 20;
  min-height: 78px;
  padding: 0 4.6vw;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(24px, 5vw, 76px);
  background: rgba(255, 253, 248, 0.94);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
}

.wordmark {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.12;
}

.wordmark-en {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 1.06rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
}

.wordmark-zh {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.nav {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: clamp(12px, 1.8vw, 28px);
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

.nav a {
  position: relative;
  padding: 27px 0;
}

.nav a::after {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 19px;
  left: 0;
  height: 1px;
  width: 0;
  content: "";
  background: var(--vermilion);
  transition: width 220ms ease;
}

.nav a:hover::after {
  width: 100%;
}

.updated {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-left: 20px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.updated strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

main {
  width: min(1400px, calc(100% - clamp(30px, 9.2vw, 128px)));
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px) 0 72px;
}

.hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(460px, 1.02fr) minmax(340px, 0.82fr);
  gap: clamp(36px, 6.5vw, 100px);
  align-items: center;
  min-height: min(575px, calc(100vh - 126px));
  margin-bottom: 46px;
}

.eyebrow {
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

h1, h2, h3 {
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

h1 {
  color: #1e4659;
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 4.75rem);
  line-height: 1.26;
}

.lead {
  margin: 26px 0 30px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 1rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

.route-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 13px;
  margin: 0 0 36px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1vw, 0.78rem);
  letter-spacing: 0.19em;
}

.route-line i {
  position: relative;
  width: clamp(16px, 3vw, 36px);
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--sand);
}

.route-line i::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: -2px;
  content: "";
  border-left: 5px solid var(--sand);
  border-top: 2px solid transparent;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
}

.countdown-card {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 13px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding-top: 18px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

.countdown-card strong {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 3.1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1;
}

.countdown-card small {
  margin-left: 16px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-left: 20px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.hero-map {
  position: relative;
  padding: 18px 18px 58px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  transform: rotate(0.75deg);
}

.hero-map::before {
  position: absolute;
  top: -15px;
  left: calc(50% - 42px);
  height: 30px;
  width: 84px;
  content: "";
  background: rgba(200, 175, 121, 0.5);
  transform: rotate(-3deg);
}

.hero-map img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: min(400px, 42vw);
  object-fit: cover;
  filter: saturate(0.92) contrast(0.98);
}

.hero-map figcaption {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 20px;
  left: 21px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-style: italic;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
}

.kpi-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
  margin-bottom: clamp(54px, 7vw, 84px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.kpi {
  min-height: 142px;
  padding: 25px clamp(13px, 1.7vw, 25px);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.kpi:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}

.kpi p {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

.kpi strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 1.85vw, 1.7rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.kpi em {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.8em;
  font-style: normal;
}

.kpi small {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.kpi.paid strong {
  color: var(--sage);
}

.kpi.pending strong {
  color: var(--vermilion);
}

.panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
  padding: clamp(22px, 3vw, 38px);
}

.journey, .spots, .notices {
  margin-bottom: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 58px);
}

.films,
.ticket-panel,
.personal-cost {
  margin-bottom: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 58px);
}

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 28px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(26px, 3vw, 38px);
}

.section-head h2 {
  color: var(--azure);
  font-size: clamp(1.62rem, 2.4vw, 2.12rem);
}

.section-head > p {
  max-width: 450px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.87rem;
}

.section-head.compact {
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.section-head.compact h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.42rem, 2vw, 1.72rem);
}

.day-filter {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}

.day-button {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-width: 62px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: transparent;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  transition: all 180ms ease;
}

.day-button:hover, .day-button.active {
  border-color: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper-light);
  background: var(--ink);
}

.day-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 15px;
}

.day-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 408px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 19px 17px;
  background: var(--paper-light);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(46, 44, 40, 0.05);
}

.day-photo {
  display: block;
  width: calc(100% + 38px);
  height: 142px;
  margin: 0 -19px 18px;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.full-itinerary {
  margin-top: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-top: clamp(25px, 3vw, 34px);
}

.subhead {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 28px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.subhead h3 {
  color: var(--azure);
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.8vw, 1.55rem);
}

.detail-days {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: end;
  gap: 6px;
  max-width: 650px;
}

.detail-button {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: transparent;
  padding: 6px 11px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.detail-button.active,
.detail-button:hover {
  border-color: var(--vermilion);
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--vermilion-soft);
}

.schedule-reader {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--paper-light);
}

.reader-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 17px 22px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.reader-title span {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
}

.reader-title h4 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.reader-title small {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.timeline {
  padding: 5px 22px 12px;
}

.timeline-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 58px 68px 1fr 40px;
  gap: 13px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--rule);
  padding: 14px 0;
}

.timeline-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.timeline-row time {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
}

.entry-kind {
  height: fit-content;
  background: var(--paper-dark);
  padding: 3px 7px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.entry-city {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.timeline-row h5 {
  margin: 3px 0 5px;
  font-size: 0.89rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.entry-note {
  max-width: 720px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}

.timeline-row a {
  align-self: start;
  color: var(--sage);
  font-size: 0.73rem;
}

.day-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.day-meta span {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
}

.day-meta strong {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.day-city {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.73rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}

.day-card h3 {
  margin-bottom: 13px;
  color: #1f5e78;
  font-size: 1.08rem;
}

.day-card ul {
  flex: 1;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 0 0 15px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.day-card li {
  margin: 0 0 5px;
}

.tag-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-top: 13px;
}

.tag-row span {
  background: var(--paper-dark);
  padding: 3px 8px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.spot-filter {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.spot-button {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: transparent;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
}

.spot-button.active, .spot-button:hover {
  border-color: var(--vermilion);
  color: var(--vermilion);
  background: var(--vermilion-soft);
}

.spot-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  gap: 9px;
}

.spot-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 102px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 12px 13px;
  background: var(--paper-light);
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--body);
  text-align: left;
  transition: border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease;
}

.spot-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--sage);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.spot-card.active {
  border-color: var(--vermilion);
  background: var(--vermilion-soft);
}

.spot-card span {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

.spot-card strong {
  flex: 1;
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.spot-card em {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-style: normal;
}

.article-explorer {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 290px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}

.guide-images {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.guide-images img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: clamp(185px, 19vw, 268px);
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top center;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.article-explorer .spot-grid {
  position: sticky;
  top: 94px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 112px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.article-explorer .spot-card {
  min-height: 85px;
}

.spot-card img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 86px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.article-reader {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--paper-light);
  padding: clamp(22px, 3.5vw, 43px);
}

.spot-photo {
  margin: 0 0 26px;
}

.spot-photo img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: clamp(235px, 31vw, 430px);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  object-fit: cover;
}

.reading-head {
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-bottom: 23px;
}

.reading-head h3 {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  color: #111827;
  font-size: clamp(1.48rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
  font-weight: 900;
}

.reading-head span {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.markdown {
  max-width: 800px;
  color: #1f2933;
  font-size: 0.91rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.84;
}

.markdown h3,
.markdown h4,
.markdown h5 {
  margin: 35px 0 13px;
  color: #111827;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.markdown p {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.markdown hr {
  height: 1px;
  margin: 34px 0;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--rule);
}

.markdown strong {
  color: #111827;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.markdown blockquote {
  margin: 28px 0;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--sand);
  padding: 5px 0 5px 19px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 1.03rem;
}

.markdown .bullet {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 16px;
}

.markdown .bullet::before {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  content: "·";
  color: var(--vermilion);
}

.finance-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.07fr 0.93fr;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 58px);
}

.payment-block {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(22px, 4vw, 42px);
  margin-bottom: 33px;
}

.donut {
  --paid: 0%;
  position: relative;
  flex: 0 0 151px;
  height: 151px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: conic-gradient(var(--sage) 0 var(--paid), var(--vermilion-soft) var(--paid) 100%);
}

.donut::after {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 17px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  content: "";
  background: var(--paper-light);
}

.donut div {
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

.donut strong {
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 1.65rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.donut span {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.payment-values p {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}

.payment-values strong {
  margin-left: 12px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  margin-right: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.dot.paid {
  background: var(--sage);
}

.dot.pending {
  background: var(--vermilion);
}

.payment-values .note {
  max-width: 260px;
  margin-top: 16px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.category-bars {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.bar-line {
  position: relative;
  padding-right: 48px;
}

.bar-line div:first-child {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.bar-line div:first-child strong {
  font-weight: 500;
}

.bar {
  height: 5px;
  background: var(--paper-dark);
}

.bar i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
}

.bar i.ink {
  background: var(--azure);
}

.bar i.sage {
  background: var(--sage);
}

.bar i.red {
  background: var(--vermilion);
}

.bar i.sand {
  background: var(--sand);
}

.bar-line small {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -6px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 99px;
  padding: 4px 11px;
  font-size: 0.69rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pill.success {
  color: #176257;
  background: #e0f1eb;
}

.pill.alert {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  background: var(--vermilion-soft);
}

.pill.neutral {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  background: var(--paper-dark);
}

.ledger {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.ledger-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 58px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.ledger-row time {
  color: var(--vermilion);
}

.ledger-row strong, .ledger-row small {
  display: block;
}

.ledger-row strong {
  font-weight: 500;
}

.ledger-row small {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.ledger-row b {
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.calculation-note {
  margin-top: 22px;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--sand);
  padding: 5px 0 5px 16px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.calculation-note strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  color: var(--vermilion);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.calculation-note b {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
}

#stay {
  margin-bottom: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 58px);
}

.stay-track {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}

.stay-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 336px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--paper-light);
}

.stay-photo {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #e9ded0;
}

.stay-photo img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.stay-card-body {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 15px 16px 13px;
}

.stay-card header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.stay-card time {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-size: 0.73rem;
}

.stay-card p {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.71rem;
}

.stay-card h3 {
  flex: 1;
  margin: 5px 0 9px;
  color: #1f5e78;
  font-size: 0.97rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.stay-card > strong {
  margin-bottom: 13px;
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.stay-card footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 7px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-top: 10px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
}

.stay-card em {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-style: normal;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.mobility-grid, .ticket-and-production {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.93fr 1.07fr;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 58px);
}

.booking-ref {
  margin: -8px 0 22px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.77rem;
}

.flight-list {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.flight {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 56px 66px 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 62px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.flight time {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-size: 0.77rem;
}

.flight > strong {
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.flight b, .flight small {
  display: block;
}

.flight b {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.flight small {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.73rem;
}

.transport-list, .ticket-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.transport {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr auto;
  gap: 13px;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 12px 13px;
  background: var(--paper-light);
}

.transport > span {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.transport strong, .transport small {
  display: block;
}

.transport strong {
  color: #1e4659;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.transport small {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.transport b {
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.ticket-and-production {
  grid-template-columns: 1.12fr 0.88fr;
}

.visual-break {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 58px);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.visual-break img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-height: 440px;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.visual-break p {
  position: absolute;
  right: 28px;
  bottom: 22px;
  max-width: 385px;
  padding: 12px 17px;
  color: #fffdf8;
  background: rgba(20, 55, 65, 0.86);
  font-family: var(--title);
}

.ticket {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 86px 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 69px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.ticket-panel .ticket-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
}

.ticket-panel .ticket {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 18px;
  background: var(--paper-light);
}

.ticket time {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-size: 0.73rem;
}

.ticket strong, .ticket small {
  display: block;
}

.ticket strong {
  color: #1e4659;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.ticket small {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.ticket b {
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.episode-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.episode-tabs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 9px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.episode-tab {
  min-height: 82px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--paper-light);
  padding: 12px 13px;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--body);
  text-align: left;
}

.episode-tab span {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
}

.episode-tab strong {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.episode-tab.active,
.episode-tab:hover {
  border-color: var(--vermilion);
  background: var(--vermilion-soft);
}

.episode-tab.active strong {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.script-reader .markdown {
  max-width: 920px;
}

.personal-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(250px, 0.7fr) 1fr;
  gap: clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px);
  align-items: center;
}

.per-person-feature {
  border-left: 2px solid var(--sand);
  padding: 10px 0 10px clamp(18px, 3vw, 30px);
}

.per-person-feature span {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

.per-person-feature strong {
  display: block;
  margin: 7px 0 15px;
  color: var(--sand);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.9rem);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.per-person-feature p {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.per-person-feature b {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.personal-bars {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 11px;
}

.personal-line {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  align-items: baseline;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 14px 4px;
}

.personal-line span {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.personal-line strong {
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.personal-line small {
  grid-column: 2;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.episode-list div {
  min-height: 61px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 11px 7px;
}

.episode-list div:nth-child(odd) {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.episode-list span {
  display: block;
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-family: var(--title);
  font-size: 0.67rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

.episode-list p {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}

.notice-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}

.notice {
  min-height: 132px;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--sand);
  padding: 17px 18px;
  background: var(--paper-light);
}

.notice span {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
}

.notice h3 {
  margin: 7px 0 8px;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.notice p {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

body > footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 30px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 22px max(calc((100vw - 1400px) / 2), 4.6vw) 28px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(14px);
  transition: opacity 600ms ease, transform 600ms ease;
}

.reveal.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

@media (max-width: 1120px) {
  body::after {
    opacity: 0.42;
    background-position:
      left -28px top 120px,
      right -34px top 160px,
      center;
  }

  .nav {
    display: none;
  }

  .topbar {
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .hero {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.86fr;
  }

  .kpi-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }

  .kpi:nth-child(3) {
    border-right: 0;
  }

  .kpi:nth-child(-n+3) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .day-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .stay-track {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .spot-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }

  .article-explorer {
    grid-template-columns: 250px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .episode-tabs {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 850px) {
  body::after {
    opacity: 0.18;
  }

  main {
    width: calc(100% - 34px);
    padding-top: 31px;
  }

  .hero {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    min-height: 0;
    margin-bottom: 39px;
  }

  .hero-map {
    order: -1;
    padding: 11px 11px 42px;
  }

  .hero-map img {
    height: min(350px, 64vw);
  }

  .route-line {
    gap: 7px;
  }

  .countdown-card {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .countdown-card small {
    flex-basis: 100%;
    margin: 12px 0 0;
    border: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .finance-layout, .mobility-grid, .ticket-and-production {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .notice-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .spot-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .subhead,
  .article-explorer {
    display: block;
  }

  .detail-days {
    justify-content: start;
    margin-top: 18px;
  }

  .article-explorer .spot-grid {
    position: static;
    display: flex;
    gap: 9px;
    max-height: none;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }

  .article-explorer .spot-card {
    flex: 0 0 200px;
  }

  .guide-images {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ticket-panel .ticket-list,
  .personal-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 610px) {
  body::after {
    display: none;
  }

  .topbar {
    min-height: 68px;
    padding: 0 17px;
  }

  .updated {
    padding-left: 12px;
  }

  h1 {
    font-size: 2.48rem;
  }

  .lead {
    margin: 18px 0 23px;
    font-size: 0.84rem;
  }

  .route-line {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    line-height: 2.1;
  }

  .kpi-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .kpi, .kpi:nth-child(3) {
    min-height: 124px;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .kpi:nth-child(even) {
    border-right: 0;
  }

  .kpi:nth-last-child(-n+2) {
    border-bottom: 0;
  }

  .panel {
    padding: 20px 15px;
  }

  .section-head {
    align-items: start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 9px;
    margin-bottom: 21px;
  }

  .day-grid, .stay-track, .notice-grid, .spot-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .day-card {
    min-height: 0;
  }

  .payment-block {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .transport, .ticket {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  }

  .transport > span, .ticket time {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  body > footer {
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 18px 17px;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .timeline {
    padding: 4px 14px 8px;
  }

  .timeline-row {
    grid-template-columns: 51px 1fr 34px;
    gap: 9px;
  }

  .timeline-row .entry-kind {
    grid-column: 2 / 3;
  }

  .timeline-row div {
    grid-column: 2 / -1;
  }

  .article-reader {
    padding: 20px 15px;
  }

  .episode-tabs,
  .personal-bars {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .visual-break p {
    right: 12px;
    bottom: 12px;
    left: 12px;
  }
}
